module_budget_change: Budget should be enforced to all packages, including new packages, not just to `flow`. (maintainer, 2026-11-23)
description: scripts/check_module_budgets.py checks only the directories listed under 'packages' in holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json, and that list holds one entry, apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/flow. Every other source module (the rest of sandbox_executor, scripts/, and any package added later) is never measured: dozens of modules are far over the 200-line default (for example calibration, review_ensemble, local_llm, git_flow, entrypoint/review_loop) and a new package outside flow/ has no limit at all. holon-coherence already enforces a discovery-based budget (Holon-Agentic-Coder/holon-coherence#55).
goal: Make the module line budget discovery-based: scripts/check_module_budgets.py covers every tracked Python source module under apps/*/src/ and scripts/ (including __init__.py files) without naming packages. Replace the 'packages' list in holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json with a short explicit 'exclude' list, each entry with a stated reason (generated or vendored code only). Keep the 200-line default. Freeze every module currently over the default with an override equal to its exact current line count; overrides only ratchet down: growing past an override fails, a module below its override produces a notice to lower it, and a new module gets the default with no override. Keep the existing frozen-configuration rule (byte-for-byte comparison with the merge base unless the intent authorises a change) and keep the check in 'uv run task lint', the pre-commit hook and CI hygiene. Test files are not budgeted in this change. Do not split or shorten any module in this change; only measure and freeze.
rationale: Budgets only on flow/ let every other package grow without limit; discovery-based coverage with frozen ratchet-down overrides stops new growth everywhere without a large refactor.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/check_module_budgets.py discovers every tracked Python source module under apps/*/src/ and scripts/ with no package allowlist; a test proves a module in a newly created package over 200 lines fails.

holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json has the 200-line default, an 'exclude' list where every entry has a reason, and one override per currently oversized module equal to its exact line count on the PR's base; the check passes on the PR head with no module changed.

Tests cover: growth of a frozen module by one line fails; shrinking produces a ratchet-down notice and does not fail; an excluded path is skipped; an exclude entry without a reason fails; __init__.py files are measured.
The frozen-configuration check still refuses changes to the budget file in flows whose intent does not authorise them.
The execution notes list the number of modules measured before and after, the number of overrides added, and the five largest overrides.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest', and 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
